_doc: Large batch L09 (Sonnet generic pass): saltwater-gharial, delta-gharial, alligator-snapper, mire-toad, elder-mire-toad, goliath-frog, reef-turtle, leatherback.

saltwater-gharial/f:b0.note: gnash is a jaw grind: bite

saltwater-gharial/f:b1.note: brine tail sweep: edge ripples, differs from Gnash

saltwater-gharial/f:b2.note: scales are armour, salt crust: shield (ripple keyword was only brine)

saltwater-gharial/f:x0.note: wallop is a heavy blow: thump blocks

saltwater-gharial/f:u1.note: spinning roll: slash streaks, kept apart from the Estuary Snap lance

delta-gharial/f:b1.note: tail sweep through the delta water: ripples

delta-gharial/f:x0.note: flop is a heavy belly drop: thump blocks

alligator-snapper/f:x0.note: lunge from a still wait: lance

alligator-snapper/f:u2.note: weed coat hides it: leaf (art beats evade default)

mire-toad/f:u1.note: belly flop splashes into mire water: ripples

mire-toad/f:u2.note: breath is a gas cloud: puff over drip

elder-mire-toad/f:u1.note: belch is a gas cloud: puff

elder-mire-toad/f:x0.note: plop is a heavy drop: thump blocks

elder-mire-toad/f:u3.note: hush into the mire water: ripple, best guess vs puff

goliath-frog/f:b2.note: huge warty hide bristles: thorn (Rubbery Skin stays the only shield)

goliath-frog/f:x0.note: smother = heavy dusty bulk sitting down: puff, best guess vs bash

reef-turtle/f:b1.note: flipper sweep through water: ripples (Flipper Slap stays slash)

reef-turtle/f:u1.note: reef shell grown over with algae: leaf, best guess vs shield
